cues.text: Thank you for joining me for this
tutorial focused on managing users in
the ArtelWare application. I have lots

So, let's go ahead and get started.
Before we begin exploring how to manage
users in ArtelWare, there are a couple
of important items to note. This
tutorial outlines the user management
for an ArtelWare installation that does
not have the Windows Active Directory
function enabled. If you are using the
Windows Active Directory feature, please
consult with your IT team for all user
management.
Secondly, only individuals that have
permissions to create users will be able
to perform the tasks outlined in this
video. We'll talk about how to identify
who has those specific permissions and
what permission set they'll need.

our Telware. There's a two-part answer
to that question. The first part of the
answer is anyone using the RTOWware
application should be created as a user.
And secondly, individuals who are listed
as owners of devices such as pipettes,
liquid handlers, or instruments should
also be created as users.
Prior to creating all of your users, the
first thing that you'll want to do
within the ArtelWare application is to
confirm that you have the proper user
groups with the correct permissions
assigned to those user groups. User
groups are located in the administration
section of the software
in the groups area.
Now, by default, our Telware comes with
these six default user groups. And then
you can navigate and see the members and
the permissions of each respective user

right hand side. So for example, if we
click on the permissions tab for the
administrators user group, you'll see
that administrators, they have
permissions to perform every task within
the software.
If I click on the operators user group,

verifications.

be listed as owners that are associated
with that particular device which might
be a pipette or an automated liquid
handler.

clicking on the user group you wish to
add permissions to and then clicking on
the edit icon which is this little
pencil to paper icon at the top center
left of the screen. From there you can
highlight the permission that you wish

right side carrot to add the permission
